The message type of the topic to monitor for publishes.
There is no default for this parameter.

The source to monitor for publishes. The source of the message
defaults to all, which monitors both publishes directly to this
AMPS instance and messages received via replication.
This parameter also accepts local for when the message source is
published directly to this AMPS instance and replicated for
messages received via replication.

Sets the filter to apply.
Only messages that match this filter will cause the action to run.

Sets the options to apply when listening for messages.
This action supports any option that would be supported by the
subscribe command when not using a bookmark.
